_comment: SERVER_SOFTWARE product (非授权 / 先付后用). publish.mjs uploads assets.sourceCodeFile as businessType product_file -> baseInfo.sourceCodeFile, then submits. Rules (see reference.md): softwareVersion x.y.z; receivePayment.productPrice >= 1; optional deployPrice must be <= productPrice x 2; serverSoftwareDeployRole MYSELF|PLATFORM.

baseInfo.summary: A paid, self-hostable server product: buy once, download the package, deploy on your own infrastructure.

introduce.functions: REST API, webhook ingestion, pluggable storage backends and an admin console.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Teams that must self-host and keep data on their own infrastructure.
introduce.usageScenarios: Deploy behind a reverse proxy for internal automation and data processing.
introduce.painPoints: SaaS-only alternatives do not meet data-residency requirements.
